entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand tracker.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number please?
Jane Doe, order number is VF88602. Look, I just need a yes or no. Can I return it?
Understood, Jane. I've pulled up your account. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue. I changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I just don't use it. So, can I send it back or not?
Okay, thanks for clarifying. Let me see... I show the delivery date was 39 days ago. Let me just double-check our return policy for you.
Alright, I've checked the system. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you're unfortunately outside the window. I can go ahead and process this for you right now.
Great. So you're sending me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 5-10 minutes. Just pack it up in the original box and drop it off.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Jane. Have a great day.
